subject: mathematics
concept: Understanding rational numbers as any number that can be written as a fraction of integers
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student expresses various values (whole numbers, decimals, fractions) as a ratio of two integers using number tiles
exercise.pictorial: Student sorts numbers into 'rational' and 'not clearly rational at this level' groups on a number line
exercise.abstract: Student classifies a given number as rational and expresses it in fraction form

misconception_flags: believes only fractions (not whole numbers or terminating decimals) count as rational numbers

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
